rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for feeling pleased or happy.

example.english: I was glad to receive a gift today.
example.traditional: 我今日收到份禮物，好開心。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 sau1 dou2 fan6 lai5 mat6 hou2 hoi1 sam1

rows.note: Use this for a somewhat more formal or emphatic expression of being pleased or happy.

example.english: I was glad to learn that you succeeded.
example.traditional: 得悉你成功，我感到十分高興。
example.jyutping: dak1 sik1 nei5 sing4 gung1 ngo5 gam2 dou3 sap6 fan1 gou1 hing3
